mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a weakening demand in the real estate sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST declines by >5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances where INDPRO increases by >1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising real personal savings (RSAFS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals increased consumer confidence and spending power, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >2% and UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances where RSAFS increases by >2% and UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances where PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.3% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances where GDPC1 increases by >1% QoQ.
